description: Complete Dragonic field optional Bolshack discount/haste, colorless all-card use reduction without a one-mana minimum plus multicolor tax/G Strike, and Baker ramp/shield cycling on entry and attack. generalRuleEvidence.scope: Do every possible instruction when the earlier shield choice cannot be made; ordinary fields are not D2 fields; no printed positive floor on Chiffon reduction, preserving floors from other applied effects.

validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Initial Sato speed-grant tests exposed the need for its native g1458FieldAura permission; the final card uses this established generic field-aura flag without falsely declaring the card a D2 field. All final Sato payment/haste/leave tests pass. The shieldless-player attack fixture now uses an explicit vanilla top card to assert the new shield is broken into hand, independent of optional S-trigger behavior in a preset library. Native mandatory opponent cycling was fixed to execute its independent ShieldTop instruction even with zero old shields; both new Baker and existing TOY are reproduced. No save/schema changes. Common zero-floor extension reuses existing QA39980/40378 minimum precedence and keeps crossing costs excluded. The first broad related run passed 377 tests but exposed two existing QA31628 failures: the phase1781 shield notification guard used findShield, which resolves only group roots, so actual newly stacked cards were incorrectly rejected. The guard now checks actual shield-card membership, preserving replacement rejection while notifying every stacked physical card. Initial failure log was archived as related-1789-initial.log; rerun focused and relevant shield regression groups after this shared fix. Use positive test-name filters when excluding long tests; negative ancestor matching can include all file children on this Node version.
